basic_details.short_information: Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh (AMU), Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 2 posts of Instructor under Advt No. 03/2026/CPC. Applications are accepted online until 28 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online at the Careers Portal.

qualification.education_qualification: (A) Master's degree with 55% marks in Home Science with specialization in Nutrition cum Dietetics / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Ag. Microbiology / Biotechnology, plus NET / SLET / SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016; 1st class Master degree required for Instructor; OR (B) Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in top 500 (QS / THE / ARWU).
qualification.details: Qualification: (A) i) A Master's degree with 55% marks (in the field of Home Science with specialization in Nutrition cum Dietetics / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Ag. Microbiology / Biotechnology either at Post Graduate level or Under Graduate level or an equivalent grade in a point-scale) in a concerned / relevant / allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university; (A) ii) Cleared NET conducted by UGC or CSIR, or a similar test accredited by UGC like SLET / SET; Ph.D. holders as per UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M. Phil / Ph. D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted; Candidates registered for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009 are exempted from NET / SLET / SET subject to five conditions certified by the Registrar / Controller of Examinations; For Instructor, 1st class Master degree in Home Science / Bio-chemistry / Microbiology / Ag. Microbiology / Biotechnology is required; OR (B) Ph.D. from a foreign university / institution ranked among top 500 in QS, THE or ARWU World University Ranking (at any time) | Other conditions: | Open to Indian nationals including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955 Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions reckoned as on the last date of submission of Application Form Relaxation in percentage of marks as per Government of India rules, wherever applicable

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed salary of Rs. 30,000 per month

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA will be paid for interview

how_to_apply: Fill the Application Form only in Online Mode at the Careers Portal https://careers.amuonline.ac.in.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- online at the Careers Portal (PwD exempted with Disability Certificate).
Take a printout of the PDF of the submitted Application Form on A-4 size paper.
Sign it and paste a recent front-facing photograph at the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of the required documents.
Send by post, superscribing post applied for, advertisement number and date on top-left of cover, to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, AMU, Aligarh-202002.
important_instructions: Separate Application Forms for each post under a different Serial Number Amendment / Corrigendum, if any, published only on the Careers Portal No document or information added after the last date of submission

content_sections.text: Qualification: (A) i) A Master's degree with 55% marks (in the field of Home Science with specialization in Nutrition cum Dietetics / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Ag.
